verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Jan-published official SDK. Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API, and its docs say you can point Anthropic SDK clients at the local server. Using another vendor's SDK against a compatible endpoint is adjacent compatibility, not an official Jan SDK, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: you can use Anthropic SDK clients pointed at your local server
Use it as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs
